caveat: Photon truncation N_CAV=6 (vs N_CAV=28 in the pure-state production data) is used for Lindblad tractability. Validated 2026-09-02 from the complete SLURM checkpoint matrix preserved in jobs 15744/15764/15784 logs: all 20 points pass the physicality gate (trace/Hermiticity/min-eigenvalue with atol=rtol=1e-10 and a 1e-4 numerical eigenvalue acceptance floor; worst min eigenvalue -1.34e-5), and the N_CAV=6 loss curve is monotonic. TRUNCATION IS NOT CONVERGED: absolute peak QFI grows with N_CAV (2962 -> 4833 at kappa=0 over N_CAV=6..12) and retention at the physical point kappa/wc=4.1e-2 falls from 16.0% (N_CAV=6) to 6.6% (N_CAV=12); the earlier ~15% retention figure at kappa/wc=1e-2 was a numerical artifact of default solver tolerances and is superseded by 61.4% at N_CAV=6 (see the DAR §8 and this validation block).
note: Mixed-state Dicke+DCE QFI under Lindblad cavity loss, validated SLURM checkpoint matrix (jobs 15744/15764/15784, 2026-09-02), N_CAV=6 row. Published reference (pure-state) peak ~2.5e5x at last window (N_CAV=28, 40 periods); the reduced-N_CAV=6 10-period pure-state peak is 2962x. Per-row diagnostics qfi_peak_time_periods, n_peak, n_avg, kappa_t_peak, and the physicality summary were restored by direct N_CAV=6 reruns with n_steps=200 and atol=rtol=1e-10; peak/SS values reproduce the validated run logs exactly.
